ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) base with a high density of high-intensity (white) linear and mottle-patterned pixels. Approximate visual ratio of 35 percent high-intensity to 65 percent low-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density white pixel clusters localized along the distal trailing edges of both lobes. Significant concentration of white linear markings radiating from the center toward the lateral tips. The central region near the peduncle is a contiguous block of low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 65 degrees. The notch depth extends approximately 15 percent of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration across the entire trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 2 to 10 pixels. Several prominent, irregular notches are visible on the mid-section of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular white pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional, high-contrast linear scars (rake marks) covering approximately 70 percent of the visible ventral surface, most prominent on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring and tissue loss along the trailing edge resulting in an irregular, jagged profile. Prominent barnacle colonization present on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-intensity white splotch on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe, contrasting sharply with the surrounding dark pigmentation.
